name: Bloodmage: Infection learned in Eternal Curse applies and procs on bleeding targets (#12406)
contract: Infection 704624 (Packleader tank tree) and its triggered debuff 707867 carried Stances 0x8000000 (Form 28, Shadowform) and SPELL_ATTR0_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED in Spell.dbc, unlike all 40 other Packleader talents (Stances 0). Because Player::IsNeedCastPassiveSpellAtLearn checks (!Stances || form matches Stances || (!form && ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED)), a Bloodmage tank who learned Infection while in Eternal Curse 800157 (Form 57, Cursed Form) never received the 704624 passive aura, so auto attacks against bleeding targets never applied Infection 707867. Clearing Stances and SPELL_ATTR0_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED on 704624 and 707867 lets Infection apply immediately when learned in Eternal Curse, proc 707867 (+1% crit taken per stack) from auto attacks against a target bleeding from Rotclaw 804197, and still never infect an unbled target taking melee hits.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Enter Eternal Curse (Form 57, Cursed Form) before learning Infection
SETUP: Cursed Form marker for Rotclaw is active
Learn Infection while already in Eternal Curse (Form 57)
DISCRIMINATING: Infection passive aura applies immediately in Eternal Curse
Apply Rotclaw bleed to the nearby target
SETUP: bleeder carries the Rotclaw bleed
DISCRIMINATING: auto attacks in Eternal Curse apply Infection to the bleeding target
Infection debuff grants +1% crit taken per stack
CONTROL: distant target was outside Rotclaw's 12 yd radius
Move into melee range of the unbled control target
CONTROL: auto attacks actually land on the unbled target
CONTROL: unbled target is never infected
